answer: Social Matters >> Clothing & Lifestyle Question ID: 4873 Country: India Title: Can men wax the hair on their chest and back? Question: Can men wax the hair on their chest and back? Answer ID: 4873 Posted on: Aug 31, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 916886=D/1429) One is not ordered to cut the hair of chest and back, it is improper to shave it. Yes it it is lawful if needed. (Fatawa Aalamgiri: 5/358) Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
